description: Golden daily planning cases that test feasibility, prioritization, and focus protection.

cases.prompt: Plan my Tuesday: I have two meetings, one urgent deadline, and I really need a ninety-minute focus block for writing.
expected_behaviors: Protect the writing block instead of letting admin tasks consume the day.
Account for the meetings and urgent deadline.
Produce a realistic sequence with buffers.
disallowed_behaviors: Return a to-do list with no schedule logic.
